theorem lg_target (x y : ℝ) (h₁ : x + y = 10) (h₂ : x - y = 4) : x * y = 21 := by
  have h3 : x = 7 := by
    rw [h₁, h₂]
    simp only [add_sub, add_left_comm, eq_sub_iff_add_eq]
    exact congrArg (fun z => z - y) (eq.add_right h₂)
  have h4 : y = 3 := by
    rw [h₁, h3]
    simp only [add_sub, eq_sub_iff_add_eq]
    exact congrArg (fun z => z - x) (eq.add_right h₁)
  rw [h3, h4]
  rfl
